"access_aimed_prompt_model": "glm-5.3-flash:cloud",

  "_section_django_port": "TCP port the bundled Django/Daphne web server binds (the chat UI + the chat WebSocket). Read by manage.py (_resolve_django_port) and applied to EVERY launch path by _apply_configured_port: the frozen double-click, the .flw file association, the frozen browser auto-open, source 'python manage.py runserver', and 'manage.py startserver'. An explicit [ipaddr:]port on the command line (e.g. 'runserver 9100') always WINS over this key. Move it off 8000 when Windows/Hyper-V has RESERVED that port and the app crashes with WinError 10013 ('an attempt was made to access a socket in a way forbidden by its access permissions'). Any free port 1-65535; default 8000; 9000 is a common safe choice. Fail-open: a missing / unreadable / out-of-range value falls back to 8000 and NEVER stops the server from starting. NOTE: a direct 'daphne'/'uvicorn' launch bypasses manage.py, so pass the port on that CLI yourself; and if you run the TeleTlamatini bridge, point its 'tlamatini.base_url' at the same port.",
  "django_port": 8000,
  "log_user_tags": true,
  "log_user_tag_style": "short",
  "log_user_tag_thread_inherit": true,
